page.overview:
Who is Blanka?

Blanka is a beast-like character hailing from Brazil from the Street Fighter series.

Blanka and several other characters from the Street Fighter II series appear in the Club Nintendo comic "Super Mario Klemp-Won-Do: Muskeln sind nicht alles!". He can be seen laughing along with the others when Mario decides to enter the "Street Fighter II grandmaster" tournament.

Mario faces Blanka as his third opponent; Toad arrives to assist Mario and gives him bananas. Mario cleverly spreads them across the ring's floor, causing Blanka to accidentally slip on one of the peels and fall right out of the boxing ring, disqualifying him and allowing Mario to advance.

Blanka appears in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate as a spirit, using his artwork from Super Street Fighter II: The New Challengers. The Blanka spirit battle being against a green Donkey Kong with a Screw Attack equipped references Blanka's beastly nature, as well as his electric-based attacks in the Street Fighter series.
